name: Santiago
tagline: Andean views and thoughtful city museums
summary: Use Santiago for museums, hillside views and a central Chile extension. Add Valparaíso or wine country as a separate excursion rather than an extra city walk.
seasonNote: Spring/autumn suit walks; winter rain can clear the air, while summer is hot and dry.
arrival: SCL connects to the city by authorized airport transport; confirm the full fare before departure.
gettingAround: Metro and short taxi rides link central areas; protect valuables in busy stations.
cashTip: Cards are common; small Chilean-peso notes help with casual food and craft purchases.
foodTip: Try empanadas de pino, pastel de choclo or seasonal produce; check ingredients.
buyTip: Buy Chilean craft and lapis-lazuli pieces only from sellers who explain origin and materials.
baseArea: Providencia or Lastarria for access and walking.

items.name: Museum of Memory and Human Rights
items.wiki: Museum of Memory and Human Rights
items.summary: A serious account of dictatorship-era abuses and democratic memory.
items.expect: Emotionally demanding material; allow time to reflect.
items.tip: Check current entry arrangements and audio-guide availability.
items.priceNote: Planning allowance for optional guide/exhibition extras; verify current admission.

whyVisit: Testimonies and records address dictatorship-era human-rights abuses.
The museum makes democratic memory a substantive part of understanding modern Chile.
visitFlow: Allow an unhurried visit and use the interpretation available.
Leave space afterward for reflection rather than another demanding activity.
items.tradeoffs: Emotionally demanding material; allow time to reflect.

dayClusters.label: Historic centre and pre-Columbian art
dayClusters.note: Keep the central square and nearby museum together, checking the museum closure day. Protect valuables in busy central streets.

dayClusters.label: City hills and Lastarria food
dayClusters.note: Use a clear-weather morning for San Cristobal, then transfer to Lastarria for lunch and a shorter Santa Lucia walk. Use the funicular/cable-car options and trim the second hill if tired.

dayClusters.label: Memory and human rights
dayClusters.note: Allow a thoughtful museum visit and time afterwards to reflect. This is a lighter day rather than an excuse to add unrelated distant stops.

dayClusters.label: Optional Los Dominicos craft outing
dayClusters.note: An additional shopping day or alternative to a museum day. Use the Metro or arranged transport to the separate eastern-city craft village; do not assume it is next to the historic centre.
